definitions.explanation: A person who is in work, whether as an employee, self-employed, or helping in a family business. The statistical word behind {就業率|しゅうぎょうりつ}.

examples.japanese: {就業者|しゅうぎょうしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えた→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: The number of employed people increased.

examples.japanese: ⟦{農業|のうぎょう}→農業：01491_nougyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{就業者|しゅうぎょうしゃ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{減|へ}り→減る：01985_heru⟧{続|つづ}けて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The number of people working in agriculture keeps falling.

examples.japanese: {総務省|そうむしょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{調査|ちょうさ}→調査：03489_chousa⟧⟦によると→〜によると：03104_niyoruto⟧、{六十五歳|ろくじゅうごさい}⟦{以上|いじょう}→以上：01308_ijou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{就業者|しゅうぎょうしゃ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{過去|かこ}→過去：00152_kako⟧⟦{最多|さいた}→最多：28216_saita⟧になった。
examples.english: According to a survey by the Ministry of Internal Affairs, the number of employed people aged 65 and over reached a record high.

notes:
Made of ⟦{就業|しゅうぎょう}→就業：32453_shuugyou⟧ (being in work) + ⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧ (person). A word of statistics and news; in conversation people say ⟦{働|はたら}いている→働く：00503_hataraku⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {就業者|しゅうぎょうしゃ}{数|すう}: number of employed people
- 〜{業|ぎょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{就業者|しゅうぎょうしゃ}: workers in the ~ industry

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{労働者|ろうどうしゃ}→労働者：23971_roudousha⟧: worker, laborer — the general word, often an employee as against an employer
- ⟦{失業者|しつぎょうしゃ}→失業者：22385_shitsugyousha⟧: unemployed person
- {雇用者|こようしゃ}: employee (in statistics) — or, confusingly, an employer in everyday use
